review_notes.evidence: RY091/4bank parallel rail exact.png; RY091/4E D10 lower rail native.png; RY091/4J B02 junction exact.png; RY091/OR_REG35 overlay 0.png
review_notes.observation: 4A D06 rises on c114 to the row26 +REG33 diamond; 4E D10 descends on a later c114 segment to the row54 +REG34 diamond; 4J B02 rises on the adjacent c115 rail to the row48 +REG35 diamond. The c114 segments are separated by blank native space and the c110 conditioned-clock rail is separate. Earlier broad-crop claims of one continuous c114 rail or a shared 4E/4J branch are superseded.

review_notes.evidence: RY091/CLOCK PO1 rail exact.png; RY091/CLOCK_PO1 overlay 0.png
review_notes.observation: The native -CLOCK PO-1 branch diamond and vertical align at c44, one text column right of the provisional auto-routed c43 path; it serves 1B, 1F, and 1K B05 inputs. The adjacent +CLOCK PO FORCED rail at c45 serves 1A, 1E, and 1J clock inputs.

The native 6B lower D05 input drops to a printed diamond on the -ROS REG BIT33 row17 rail. The 6D D05✲ output runs separately to the -IND ROSDR BIT33 continuation on row26; the earlier provisional return U is absent in the TIFF.

review_notes.evidence: RY091/2L 3L lower positions.png; RY091/CLOCK PO2 full native strip.png
review_notes.observation: The printed T06AA 2L box has a D05 output feeding 3L B10 and a distinct right-side B05 terminal that bends down to the +CLOCK PO-2 continuation. The left-side B05 source terminates at 2L and does not directly traverse the page.

review_notes.evidence: RY091/OR_REG34 bend native.png; RY091/OR_REG34 lower rail native.png; RY091/bit34 6bank source.png
review_notes.observation: The 2E B09 output branches at its native diamond and descends on the c91 rail to 6H B09. It crosses the row44 +ROS REG BIT34 line without a diamond. That right-side continuation rises to 6F B13 on a separate c161 segment; no native path joins it to 2E B09 or 5E D13.

review_notes.evidence: RY091/vertical rails 4-bank original.png; RY091/vertical rails 4-bank lower original.png; RY091/OR_REG33 overlay 0.png; RY091/OR_REG34 overlay 0.png
review_notes.observation: The 4B B04 and 4F D12 feedback inputs cross adjacent register-feed verticals with plain plus signs. The c114 rail has separated bit-33 and bit-34 segments; c115 serves the later bit-35 4J branch and, after a native gap, the 4K feedback return.

review_notes.evidence: RY091/right continuation source audit.json; all 18 right drivers and printed reference diamonds checked against enlarged TIFF crops
review_notes.independent_review_focus: Long internal bends on CLOCK_PO1, CLOCK_CONDITIONED, CJ_FEEDBACK, INV_REG35 and bit-35 distribution require source cross-check after the corrected 4-bank register-branch separation.

review_notes.location: Source-checked short bends and adjacent bit-35 rails
review_notes.evidence: RY091/BB_TO_BG overlay 0.png; RY091/CE_TO_CJ overlay 0.png; RY091/INV_REG35 overlay 1.png; RY091/OR_REG35 overlay 1.png; RY091/BH_TO_CD overlay 0.png; RY091/BK_TO_CG overlay 1.png; RY091/CK_FEEDBACK overlay 0.png
review_notes.observation: Native bends use c130 for the 4-to-5 bank pairs and c176 for the 6-to-7 bank pairs. The 3J D06 lower return follows c107; the bit-35 2J branch into 7K uses c184. The separate bit-35 latch-output rails use c199 for the 5J B12 continuation and c200 for the 7J D02 feedback. Their close parallel lines cross other bit-35 outputs without joining.

review_notes.evidence: RY091/CLOCK_PO1 overlay 0.png; RY091/SENSE34 overlay 0.png; RY091/4bank parallel rail exact.png; RY091/vertical rails 4-bank original.png; RY091/2L 3L lower positions.png; RY091/OR_REG35 overlay 1.png
review_notes.observation: AB10, AC35 and AD38 are plain crossings of the separate c45 forced-clock rail with other input lines. BA7 and BC35 are plain crosses where conditioned-clock input lines pass vertical register feeds. AS75 is the CN_TO_AS endpoint at 3L B10, and CM68 is the OR_REG35 endpoint at 7K D09; those two are not unrelated-net crossings.
